task.title: Migrating QuayEcosystem to QuayRegistry
task.shortdesc: To migrate an existing QuayEcosystem to a QuayRegistry managed by the Red Hat Quay Operator, add the migration label to the QuayEcosystem custom resource and wait for the new QuayRegistry to start. You can then verify the migration and delete the old QuayEcosystem.

step.cmd: Add "quay-operator/migrate": "true" to the metadata.labels of the QuayEcosystem.
Wait for a QuayRegistry CR to be created with the same metadata.name as your QuayEcosystem. The QuayEcosystem CR is marked with the label "quay-operator/migration-complete": "true".
After the status.registryEndpoint of the new QuayRegistry is set, access Red Hat Quay and confirm that all data and settings were migrated successfully.
If everything works correctly, you can delete the QuayEcosystem. Kubernetes garbage collection cleans up all old resources.
